# @solana-programs/kamino-klend

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@solana-programs/kamino-klend.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/kamino-klend)

TypeScript client for the Kamino Lending (klend) program on its own, without Kamino Farms

<!-- Generated by `bun run codegen` from programs/kamino-klend/. Edit programs/kamino-klend/README.md instead. -->

## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/kamino-klend @solana/kit
```

## Usage

```typescript
import {
  fetchLendingMarket,
  getInitLendingMarketInstruction,
} from "@solana-programs/kamino-klend";

// Fetch account data
const lendingMarket = await fetchLendingMarket(rpc, marketAddress);

// Create instructions
const instruction = getInitLendingMarketInstruction({
  // ... instruction parameters
});
```

[`@solana-programs/kamino-lending`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/kamino-lending) bundles this package with the Kamino Farms program ([`@solana-programs/kamino-farms`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/kamino-farms)), which lending reserves and obligations stake into.

## Program

- Name: `kaminoLending`
- Address: `KLend2g3cP87fffoy8q1mQqGKjrxjC8boSyAYavgmjD`
- Reference: [docs/kamino-lending.md](./docs/kamino-lending.md)

## Linked programs

This program links to nodes of the following programs. Their generated code is imported from their own packages rather than duplicated here:

- `farms`: [`@solana-programs/kamino-farms`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/kamino-farms)
